purpose: Test bounded result-log return before any model/GPU workload
script:
import base64,hashlib,json,random
r=random.Random(17)
payload=bytes(r.randrange(256) for _ in range(16384))
encoded=base64.b64encode(payload).decode('ascii')
chunks=[encoded[i:i+1024] for i in range(0,len(encoded),1024)]
for i,chunk in enumerate(chunks): print('TEMPORAL_PROBE_CHUNK '+json.dumps({'i':i,'n':len(chunks),'data':chunk}),flush=True)
print('TEMPORAL_PROBE_DONE '+json.dumps({'bytes':len(payload),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),'chunks':len(chunks)}),flush=True)
